summary: The account02/B16 averaged absolute spectral-Wiener obligation cannot hold universally: for n=3, A=I_3 and iid Uniform[-1/2,1/2], B=0 and Psi_t factors into three sinc transforms, each with infinite L1 norm, so W(t)=infinity for every t although Q has a bounded continuous density. The sufficient implication remains valid; only its promotion to a universal bridge is refuted. A replacement L3_t square-channel lemma retains time cancellation and closes three independent quadratic channels.
